blocks.text: Guyana’s crown jewel: transfer to Ogle (Eugene F. Correia) airport for a 50-minute flight over pristine rainforest to Kaieteur National Park, home of the Kaieteur Falls, a single drop of about 226 m (741 ft) and one of the most powerful waterfalls in the world. After about two hours at the falls, fly back to Georgetown for a tour of its highlights: the Botanical Gardens, St George’s Cathedral, the Stabroek Market and other heritage sites. In the evening, transfer to the international airport for the flight to Paramaribo, Suriname, where your driver-guide meets you. The order of the Guyana tours may be swapped depending on the Kaieteur flight. (B)
